extras: Local-first with zero telemetry and no network requests; beta channel available via BRAT; saves as .canvuspp files with JSON Canvas 1.0 compatibility and backward-compatible .umlcanvas support.
intentEvidence: Designed as an extensible supercharged upgrade to the default Obsidian Canvas
problem: The default Obsidian Canvas lacks freehand drawing, shape recognition, formal UML modeling, and structured tables for detailed diagramming.

relations.evidence: external AI coding agents (such as Google Antigravity) to safely inspect and patch diagrams

summary: Visual diagramming canvas for Obsidian with freehand shape detection, UML 2.x modeling, interactive tables, and AI coding agent integration.
